results.title: Human
results.overview: Follows Dani Ferris, alone and exhausted, who seeks a moment of digital distraction before bed but instead gets thrust into a blood-drenched supernatural nightmare filled with horrors and heartbreak.

results.title: El Hijo
results.overview: When a mentally-ill father sends his son to hunt on his own for the first time, he is faced with the consequences of his masculine principles.

results.title: Hôtel de la Paix
results.overview: Karim, his fiancée Mouna and his father Miloud are celebrating the start of their hôtel, L'HÔTEL DE LA PAIX. But when a plumber discovers a mysterious object in the wall, a series of paranormal events happen.

results.title: GIRLS BAND CRY The Movie: Hey, Our Future
results.original_title: 劇場版総集編 ガールズバンドクライ 【後編】 なぁ、未来。
results.overview: After forming the band Togenashi Togeari, Nina confronts her issues at the hometown she escaped from. Momoka also confronts Diamond Dust, the band that she left. Their overcoming of the past inspires the others to do the same, and aim to become pro musicians, but they are unable to adapt to the demands of society and decide to continue as an indie band.

results.title: Calixta
results.overview: In the dwelling of mysterious fortune teller Calixta, young Lúcia drinks from a series of mystical teas, each one embodying a life-altering choice. As the haunting presence of the Lurker of Loops grows closer, she must face the terror of her own indecision. “Calixta” is a surrealist descent into a psychic labyrinth, where faith, fear and freedom collide in a ritual of silence and shadow.

results.title: Cecilia Bartolomé: So far, so close
results.original_title: Cecilia Bartolomé: Tan lluny, tan a prop
results.overview: Cecilia Bartolomé, a filmmaker, screenwriter, and producer from Alicante, is a pioneer of Spanish cinema. Mistreated by censorship, she still preserves at 80 the free spirit that has always defined her. We will journey with her through a fascinating life, a vital body of work, and a struggle that remains—so far, yet so close.

results.title: El gizmo
results.overview: David-Isaías, a charismatic but decadent hoax artist, becomes obsessed with impressing legendary filmmaker Mr. Welles after a drunken romantic encounter with Miss Hayworth, the director's wife. To this end, he visits Welles' studio with his latest creation: The Gizmo, a mysterious brass tube that promises to photograph thoughts.

results.title: Love Is Overrated
results.overview: Diagnosed «crap with girls» by his friends, Anis’ love life has barely a pulse. Three years after the loss of Isma, his best friend and mentor, Anis takes his courage in both hands and decides finally to get out and meet people again. And the person he meets is Madeleine. Thinking she’s way out of his league, Anis gets tangled in a web of silly lies trying to impress her. But something huge is about to start. An unexpected thing. A thing called love.

results.title: The Juice of Evil
results.overview: Drag icon Nina Queer sends the aging disco diva Anastasia Palmovsky on a bloody escape from the youth welfare office, grandma Brunhilde - and her own demons. Also starring: Magda von Pfeffer, Tatjana Berlin, Jürgen Vogel, Ingo Raabe, Rolf Scheider and many more.

results.title: Mama: Pesan Dari Neraka
results.overview: After her famed tarot-reader mother dies, Putri receives strange messages from her phone number. She ignores them — until the predictions come true.

results.title: Through Sickness and Hell
results.overview: When a police officer is trapped in a toxic marriage, he must find the strength to break free from his abusive wife, risking his career, reputation, but also his life as he battles the damaging stigma surrounding domestic violence against men.

results.title: The Cavern Crimes
results.overview: An intense suspense thriller with an attractive blend of crime and mystery set in the unique historical backdrop of the Atapuerca paleontological site, home of the oldest human remains outside of Africa.

results.title: Brighter Days
results.overview: Saho Takahashi, capable but a disillusioned nurse, has lost all motivation for her job working at Sumidaku Sakuraoka General Hospital. She seeks solace in the company of her bed-ridden patient, former Honorary Head Nurse, Sae Yukino. As she opens up about her despair, a sudden earthquake sends Saho into the depths of a strange, unfamiliar jungle.

results.title: Married to El Chapo: Emma Coronel Speaks
results.original_title: Married to El Chapo: Emma Coronel Speaks
results.overview: Swept off her feet by Mexico's most notorious drug lord at just seventeen, Emma Coronel, El Chapo's wife, reflects on her husband's crimes, their tumultuous marriage, and her time in prison, all while grappling with her own accountability.

results.title: Thunderbolt Fantasy: The Final Chapter
results.original_title: Thunderbolt Fantasy 東離劍遊紀 最終章
results.overview: In a world inhabited by cool puppets, brave heroes fight to prevent magic swords from falling into the wrong hands. Stylishly choreographed duels, double-crossings, mystical powers, and cool one-liners…

results.title: Detective Smiley & the Lost Friends
results.overview: It's the story of Detective Smiley's latest investigation, but it's also the story of Elias Baucasse, a missing activist. A do-it-yourself epic in 2020s France.

results.title: Reprogrammed
results.overview: In retro-future Los Angeles, a lonely woman creates a sentient robot and, in the process, is forced to confront her neglected life and fractured relationship with her father-learning what it truly means to be alive.

results.title: Calcetines
results.overview: In the 1990s, Rafa and Álvaro are quietly in love, forced to keep their relationship hidden from those around them. As they navigate the pressures of secrecy and societal judgment, a seemingly small mistake—Álvaro leaving behind a pair of socks—leads Rafa’s grandmother to uncover their connection. Her discovery triggers a series of events that unravel long-held family secrets and reveal unexpected truths about the past Rafa and Álvaro thought they understood.

results.title: Blood Type
results.overview: In the freezing cold of occupied Leningrad, a group of children is sent to a so-called “children’s shelter” — a place where hunger, brutal punishment, and forced labor await, and where they are even used as blood donors for wounded German soldiers. Fear, despair, and the constant threat of death haunt their every moment. Yet, amidst the cruelty, they find strength and begin secretly planning their escape. Every small act of defiance becomes a spark of hope. In the face of unimaginable terror, they fight to survive and cling to the fragile possibility of freedom.
